verified_facts.text: The hotel overlooks the waterfront of Grand Canal Square.
verified_facts.excerpt: It overlooks the waterfront of Grand Canal Square and is conveniently located near main points of interest such as the 3Arena, Bord Gáis Energy Theatre and the Grafton Street shopping hub.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Dublin's regenerated Docklands.
verified_facts.excerpt: Part of the regenerated Docklands that exemplify the city

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a sleek, contemporary building inspired by the elements.
verified_facts.excerpt: Anantara The Marker Dublin Hotel is a sleek, contemporary landmark inspired by the elements and overlooking the waterfront of Grand Canal Square.

verified_facts.text: The spa has a 23 metre infinity pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxurious spa with 23 metre infinity pool

verified_facts.text: The spa and wellness centre includes a sauna, a jacuzzi and a eucalyptus-infused steam room.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Spa and Wellness Centre includes an infinity pool, sauna, jacuzzi and eucalyptus infused steam room along with showers, lockers and changing facilities.

verified_facts.text: The Rooftop Bar & Terrace offers 360-degree views of the cityscape.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Rooftop Bar & Terrace offering 360⁰ views of the cityscape

verified_facts.text: The Rooftop Bar & Terrace opens from April to September.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Rooftop Bar & Terrace is only open during warmer summer months (April – September).

verified_facts.text: Forbes Street by Gareth Mullins serves a modern Irish menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: Anantara The Marker Dublin Hotel features the Forbes Street by Gareth Mullins restaurant and its sophisticated modern Irish menu as well as the charming Rooftop Bar & Terrace.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Dublin and the mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: offer views of Dublin and the mountains from striking floor-to-ceiling windows.

verified_facts.text: Rooms measure 30 to 35 square metres.
Suites come as studios or with one or two bedrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Studio, one or two bedrooms

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms are marble and stocked with Malin+Goetz toiletries.
verified_facts.excerpt: marble bathrooms stocked with Malin+Goetz toiletries, and bathtubs (as well as showers) round out the offerings.

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature pops of neon green and vivid purple.
verified_facts.excerpt: With pops of neon green and vivid purple, the rooms are stylish but not overdone

verified_facts.text: The rooftop hosts free yoga classes for guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: The rooftop isn’t only for drinking—it hosts free yoga classes for guests.

verified_facts.text: A local expert leads a storytelling tour through the historic Dublin Docklands.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join our local expert on a storytelling tour through the historic Dublin Docklands.

verified_facts.text: Guests can learn to craft an Irish coffee guided by a local coffee master.
verified_facts.excerpt: Learn the art of crafting the perfect Irish coffee guided by a local coffee master.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of College Green plaza and the Grafton Street shopping hub.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is close to the IFSC and the Convention Centre Dublin.
verified_facts.excerpt: It is conveniently close to the IFSC and the Convention Centre Dublin.

verified_facts.text: Parking is operated off-site with a local partner, with self-parking and valet options.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is pet friendly.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pet friendly

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler calls the building the unofficial landmark of the Docklands, known as the Silicon Docks.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Marker Hotel, a sleek geometric building in the middle of Grand Canal Square, is the district’s unofficial landmark.

verified_facts.text: If a room is not ready at arrival, guests may still use the Spa and Wellness Centre.
